name: INTRUDERS 👁
desc:
game still in development expect bugs
new updates weekly

you wake up in the attic. the window out is sealed 
four keys. search quietly. it hunts by sound, not by sight, you must navigate the series of connected vents and use sounds to distract something trapped down here. and sometimes that something is one of you.

monster design inspired by Draxxom (instagram).
 lobby music: "Haunted Title Screen Ambient - Horror Piano (Coghezzi)" by TommasoMotteran

scripts.title: Highlight the Monster
scripts.script:
local monster = workspace:FindFirstChild("Monster")

if not monster then
	warn("Monster not found!")
	return
end

local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
hl.Name = "Glow"
hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
hl.Parent = monster

local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
gui.Name = "NameTag"
gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
gui.AlwaysOnTop = true

local offset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
if monster:IsA("Model") then
	gui.Adornee = monster.PrimaryPart or monster:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	if monster:FindFirstChild("Head") then
		gui.Adornee = monster.Head
		offset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	end
else
	gui.Adornee = monster
end
gui.ExtentsOffset = offset

local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
txt.Text = "Monster"
txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
txt.TextSize = 28
txt.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
txt.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
txt.Parent = gui

gui.Parent = monster
